```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
dyad_info <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "dyad_info.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
hearing_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "hearing_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ges_summary <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "ges_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

excluded_coop_ids <- demographics %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP", excluded) %>%
  distinct(id)

```

## Full Study 1 sample (before exclusions)

```{r}
dem_coop_full <- demographics %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP")

dem_coop_full %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    n_unique_ids = n_distinct(id),
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_female = sum(gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_male = sum(gender == "Male", na.rm = TRUE),
    language_danish = sum(language == "Danish", na.rm = TRUE),
    language_other = sum(language == "Other", na.rm = TRUE),
    is_parent = sum(parent == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    have_experience = sum(experience == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    regular_exposure = sum(regular == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

dem_coop_full %>%
  count(id, name = "n_people_in_id") %>%
  count(n_people_in_id)

```

## Analytic Study 1 sample (after exclusions)

```{r}
dem_coop_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP", !excluded)

dyad_info_analytic <- dyad_info %>%
  filter(!excluded_dyad)
```

```{r}
dem_coop_analytic %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    n_dyads = n_distinct(id),
    n_valid_mixed_gender = sum(dyad_info_analytic$valid_mixed_gender_dyad, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_female = sum(gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_male = sum(gender == "Male", na.rm = TRUE),
    language_danish = sum(language == "Danish", na.rm = TRUE),
    language_other = sum(language == "Other", na.rm = TRUE),
    is_parent = sum(parent == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    have_experience = sum(experience == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    regular_exposure = sum(regular == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

dem_coop_analytic %>%
  count(id, name = "n_people_in_id") %>%
  count(n_people_in_id)

dem_coop_analytic %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    n_unique_ids = n_distinct(id),
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    language_danish = sum(language == "Danish", na.rm = TRUE),
    language_other = sum(language == "Other", na.rm = TRUE),
    is_parent = sum(parent == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    have_experience = sum(experience == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    regular_exposure = sum(regular == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```


## Excluded Study 1 participants

```{r}
demographics %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP", excluded) %>%
  select(id, participant.code, gender, position, setup, age, parent) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(id, position)
```
